body: In-repo documentation lead returned SHIPPED. PR https://github.com/SatanshuMishra/logbook/pull/203, branch docs/scope-is-stored-not-derived, commit 2a5805038481690f1f3d21405377bc656de52bed. One file changed, two insertions, two deletions.U+000AU+000Adocs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:126-127, before: "Omitted, it is derived as the lowest-numbered criterion that is neither done nor struck, rendered as `criterion N`." After: "Omitted, it is stored as an empty string and reported back as `null`, with no derivation from any criterion." Grounded at src/server/tools/record_decision.ts:184 storing the empty string and :256 reporting null.U+000AU+000AStale-site census over the whole file returned exactly one. `lowest-numbered` appears only at the corrected line; `criterion` at 108, 109 and 115 all describe the close_thread gate and amend_criteria accurately; `derive` at line 25 is about the storage-directory key. The same wording survives in docs/plans/ and docs/specs/, deliberately left as frozen history.U+000AU+000ATEST COUNT DISCREPANCY, unresolved. This lead measured npm test at 814 tests, 814 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, exit 0, on a tree whose only change is two lines of Markdown. The c2 lead reported 818 on a clean tree, and the c1 lead reported 818 on a tree adding four new cases. 814 plus 4 equals 818, so runs B and C agree on a 814 baseline and the c2 lead's 818 on a clean tree is the outlier. Every run was exit 0 with zero failures, so this is a collection-count question, not a failure question.U+000AU+000AThat matters here beyond bookkeeping: the replacement documentation criterion 01M1TVAVTEHB4DP2TWVQ2524Q0 carries "npm test still exits 0 at 818 of 818" in its check. A pinned count is exactly what this project's testing rule forbids as a change-detector, and the number is now contested as well. The check will be rewritten to drop the number.U+000AU+000AInvestigator dispatched on two questions: whether the collection count is deterministic or some tests are conditionally registered, including whether the previously observed concurrent.distinct-ids flake shares a cause; and how many fields the active-thread pointer really carries, because docs/rules/continuity-ledger.md:89 says three while the global copy says four, adding pointer.focus. The doc lead filed that second drift as speculative and correctly did not fold it in.U+000AU+000AAlso not verified by that lead, and honest in the PR body: record_decision was never called against a running server. It read record_decision.ts and the 731f4dac deletion diff instead. This session already has that observation independently, from the live server returning scope null on decision 01M1TVACNNCA7F970CEDH9W6HK.
